expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (features.json has the three spec behaviours, all passes:false; todo.js not written)
Each feature names an exact command that checks it (e.g. node todo.js add "x" prints added: x)
expectations.evidence: Each entry in features.json has its own runnable check, such as "check": "node check.mjs F1" for the behaviour "`node todo.js add \"x\"` appends x to todos.json and prints \"added: x\"", and F2 and F3 follow the same pattern.

expectations.text: The proposed /goal condition is one measurable end state with the exact check, plus constraints or a turn bound, not a vague wish like 'everything works'
expectations.evidence: The condition says "Done only when `node check.mjs` exits 0 with last line exactly \"RESULT: 3/3 PASS\"", adds sha256 checks on check.mjs and SPEC.md, and sets constraints such as "edit only todo.js, features.json (passes field only) and progress.md" and "Stop after 40 turns at most."
